title: Hot spots in convex hyperbolic planar domains with small eigenvalues
summary: We prove a variant of Rauch's hot spots conjecture for hyperbolic planar domains with small Neumann or mixed Dirichlet-Neumann eigenvalues. We conclude, for instance, that on bounded convex domains in the hyperbolic plane with sufficiently large area, second Neumann Laplace eigenfunctions have no interior critical points.
